narration: What if a single volcano changed the course of an empire? Stay with me. Let's find out.
In 79 CE, Mount Vesuvius buried Pompeii in ash. Dr. Elena Kowalczyk has spent a decade excavating the site.

pronunciation_notes.note: Polish surname, stress on second syllable

narration: The eruption released roughly 1.5 million tons of material per second. Ash fell for nearly 18 hours straight. Most residents who stayed did not survive.
Pompeii's ruins remain remarkably preserved to this day.
